introduction_markdown:
**GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD - General Certificate of Education Examination. JUNE 2025, ADVANCED LEVEL. English Language, Paper 2 (0730).**

Answer your questions either exclusively from **PART ONE (NEW SYLLABUS)** or from **PART TWO (OLD SYLLABUS)**.

**PART ONE (NEW SYLLABUS) - Duration: Two and a Quarter Hours.** Instructions to candidates: ANSWER ONE QUESTION FROM EACH SECTION (Section A: Composition, Section B: Prescribed Texts, Section C: Creative Writing). ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Read all instructions on BOTH the question paper and the answer booklet very carefully. Failure to obey these instructions or to number your work as on the question paper will cause you to lose marks. Any unusual mark, sign or unnecessary disclosure of your identity will be considered as an attempt to cheat and will earn you a penalty. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. A pre-prepared or memorised composition will earn you no marks.

**PART TWO (OLD SYLLABUS) - Duration: Three Hours.** Instructions to candidates: Answer BOTH questions in SECTION A and ONE EACH from SECTIONS B and C in the SAME Answer Booklet, beginning each section on a new page. Read all instructions on BOTH the question paper and the answer booklet very carefully. Failure to obey these instructions or to number your work as on the question paper will cause you to lose marks. Any unusual mark, sign or unnecessary disclosure of your identity will be considered as an attempt to cheat and will earn you a penalty. In the SUMMARY question, use mainly your own words. Indiscriminate copying of portions of the passage as your answer will earn you little or no marks. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. A pre-prepared or memorised composition will earn you little or no marks.

Les regles_choix sont identiques dans les 24 fichiers : NEW SYLLABUS - SECTION A 1 sur 6, SECTION B 1 sur 4, SECTION C 1 sur 2 ; OLD SYLLABUS - SECTION B 1 sur 6, SECTION C 1 sur 4 ; la Section A de la Part Two est obligatoire (aucune règle).

Convention de numérotation (sujet à deux parties) : numero_exercice « NEW-A1 » à « NEW-A6 », « NEW-B1 » à « NEW-B4 », « NEW-C1 » et « NEW-C2 » pour la Part One ; « OLD-A1 » et « OLD-A2 », « OLD-B1 » à « OLD-B6 », « OLD-C1 » à « OLD-C4 » pour la Part Two. duree_epreuve vaut « 3h » partout (durée de la Part Two, la plus longue) ; la Part One dure 2h15 (voir introduction_markdown).

Section C : 20 marks par question (imprimé) ; la répartition des points entre contenu, forme et expression n'est pas imprimée : la grille est indicative. Le compte de mots du dialogue modèle inclut les noms des interlocuteurs.

questions.enonce_markdown: **1.** You received a letter from your father which simply said, 'Ask your mother who your biological father is.' In not more than 250 words, present the discussion you had with your mother. (20 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Model answer (229 words, including the speakers' names)**

**Setting: the sitting room, evening. I come in with the letter in my hand.**

**Me:** Mama, I received this from Papa. It says only: "Ask your mother who your biological father is."

**Mama:** (sitting down slowly) So he has finally written it.

**Me:** Then it is true? The man who raised me is not my father?

**Mama:** I meant to tell you when you were older. Before I met Papa, I knew a young man called Ebanga. He travelled abroad before I knew I was expecting you. I never heard from him again.

**Me:** And Papa?

**Mama:** He married me, knowing everything, and he gave you his name. This letter comes from anger, not from truth about his heart. We quarrelled about money last month.

**Me:** Why did you hide it from me for twenty years?

**Mama:** I was afraid of losing you, and ashamed. I was wrong to be silent. Forgive me.

**Me:** (after a long pause) I am hurt, Mama, but I am not angry with you. I would like to know who he is.

**Mama:** I will help you search, if you wish. But remember that a father is the one who stays, who pays the school fees and sits at night beside your sickbed. That man is Papa.

**Me:** (holding her hand) Then I will call him tonight, and we shall talk as a family.

**Why it earns the marks**

| Criterion | What earns the marks |
|---|---|
| Content | The letter, the question, the mother's explanation, the emotions of both and a resolution, all within the 250-word limit |
| Form | A clear dialogue: each speaker is named, the stage directions are short, the exchange sounds natural |
| Expression and accuracy | Controlled, sensitive language; correct punctuation of direct speech |

**Common mistakes**

1. Exceeding 250 words, or writing a narrative with no real discussion.
2. A dialogue with no feeling: the situation is emotional, so the characters must react.
3. Forgetting speaker labels or quotation marks, which makes the dialogue hard to follow.
